chunks: And how many generations have We destroyed before them? Do you perceive of them any one, or hear from them any sound or whisper?
ai.seo_question: What does the term 'rikz' mean in the context of the destruction of previous nations in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Maryam, this verse underscores the totality of divine retribution against past civilizations, using the rhetorical question to highlight the erasure of their memory and presence. The term 'rikz' (a faint sound or trace) emphasizes that not even a whisper of their existence remains, serving as a potent warning to the contemporaries of the Prophet regarding the fate of those who rejected divine messengers.
